test_title: PYST 02: SSC JE ME - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is Z related to V if ‘Z ÷ X − C ÷ V × B + N’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Husband
 Father
 
 

 

Given: Z ÷ X - C ÷ V × B + N

It means: Z is the Father of X, X is the Brother of C, C is the Father of V, V is the Husband of B, B is the Mother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008c64348693e13a8675e5e56cea58f5da00fd49f614114d02d4e2428112b478.png] 

So, Z is the **Father's father** of V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
